en: The postcard depicts a black-and-white photograph of a busy beach scene with many people swimming and playing in the waves. The beach appears lively, with a wooded coastline visible in the background. On the front, there is printed bilingual text in Bulgarian and French, identifying the scene. The reverse side features handwritten text, a red Bulgarian stamp commemorating 1888–1938, and a postmark from Varna. The address is written to someone in Prague, Czechoslovakia (now Czechia).
